in_sanskrit.name: पापन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Papan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pita', which means 'father'. In Hindu culture, the term 'papa' is also used to refer to a father. Thus, Papan can be interpreted as 'the one who resembles or acts like a father'.
